meeting.summary: Discussion only, apart from a 4-0 vote to go into closed session. Councilmember Wood was excused and Councilmember Huish joined electronically. Budget Manager Terrence Dela Peña opened the Fiscal Year 2028 budget process. Lessons from last year: clearer performance and service-level measures, earlier and more frequent council check-ins, and more resident input. The timeline runs from a staff kickoff on October 22, 2026 to a public hearing and adoption on June 15, 2027, with council discussions, a Budget Congress for departments and a budget open house along the way. The council discussed how to explain the budget to residents through the channels they use most and make budget information easier to find.
